text:
maria: Quick FYI — Customer reported routing to v1 even though v1 is sunset for that tenant. Console shows deprec banner in the preview, but the quota meter for the route still counts against v1 and v2. :eyes:
aj: Which header are they sending? sticky header or version param?
devon: We've got telemetry spikes for `x-redwood-version: v1-sticky` from that tenant id=tenant_824. Fallback logic kicked in when v2 capacity throttled.
maría: repro steps from customer pasted below (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" \
  -H "x-redwood-version: v1-sticky" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
tanvi: So console preview shows the deprecated badge but the per-route meter is still summing requests to both v1 and v2? That will confuse billing.
lucas: Confirmed bug: when header fallback triggers, quota-emitter tags both route=api/v2 and legacy_route=v1 in the same span. Downstream billing aggregates both -> double charge. :bug:
aj: Oof. Can we short-circuit metric tagging on fallback? Minimal change: add a check in routing layer to set `legacy_route` only if original host matches legacy domain.
devon: Quick telemetry stats: fallback rate for tenant_824 = 12% over last 6h, errors jump when v2 CPU saturation > 80%. We should prioritize a soft-fix before a full rollout.
maria: Proposal: 1) console: show "active route" in preview (explicitly display which variant was used), 2) short-term server patch to stop emitting duplicate route tags on fallback, 3) alert for tenants with >5% fallback in 1h.
tanvi: For console UX, I can add an additional column in the preview table: "served_variant" and a tooltip explaining fallback semantics. Will mock tomorrow.
lucas: Patch idea (in routing):
```
if (fallbackTriggered) {
  // previously: emit both tagged routes
  emitRouteTag(servedVariant);
  // DO NOT emit legacy tag unless request Host == legacy-host
}
```
aj: Sounds good. Who can own the patch + canary? Devon volunteer?
devon: I can do the server patch and a tiny sampling canary to 5% tenants. Will coordinate deploy window.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by devon for routing-service patch -> canary to 5% at 2024-11-05T18:30Z. CI green.
maria: Thx — next steps: devon push patch, lucas add unit test for tag suppression, tanvi land console preview column. I'll add an item in the deprecation runbook: verify "served_variant" docs and billing check.
aj: Also add a telemetry alert (metric: fallback_rate > 5% for 1h) and a runbook link in the alert.
tanvi: Adding mock screenshot to `/internal/designs/console-deprec-preview.png` and will ping for review. :+1:
lucas: Will follow up with a small billing audit to reconcile any double-charges for tenant_824 for the last 24h.
maria: Great. Marking this thread resolved when patch is in prod + console column shipped. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
